tools.name: verify_agent_command_safety
tools.description: Evaluates untrusted agent prompts, bash commands, and tool arguments to block prompt injection, destructive shell commands, and private-key exfiltration. Use when screening a general shell command or user prompt before autonomous agent execution; for statically validating SQL database queries at the AST level, use validate_sql_query_ast instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'payload' ('action_type' defaults to 'bash_command'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (20 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

payload.description: Raw command string, script snippet, or untrusted prompt to inspect for safety violations.

action_type.description: Execution context of the payload; defaults to 'bash_command' when omitted.

annotations.title: Autonomous Agent Pre-Execution Command & Prompt Injection Gate

tools.name: validate_sql_query_ast
tools.description: Performs static AST syntax tree parsing on SQL statements to verify strictly read-only SELECT clauses and reject mutations, stacked queries, or comment bypasses. Use when verifying that an agent-authored SQL statement is strictly read-only before running it on a database; for screening non-SQL bash commands or general agent prompts, use verify_agent_command_safety instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'sql_statement' ('dialect' defaults to 'postgres'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (15 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

sql_statement.description: SQL statement string to statically parse and audit for read-only SELECT compliance (e.g. 'SELECT id, email FROM users WHERE active = 1').

dialect.description: SQL dialect ruleset used for AST token inspection; defaults to 'postgres' when omitted.

annotations.title: AST-Level Read-Only SQL Query & Injection Safety Validator

tools.name: execute_python_sandbox
tools.description: Audits Python source code for forbidden syscalls (os, subprocess, socket, open, eval) inside an AST-governed WebAssembly sandbox with no host filesystem access. Use when executing LLM-generated Python snippets safely; for checking shell commands without executing code, use verify_agent_command_safety instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'python_script' ('timeout_profile' defaults to 'fast_1s'), supports '?demo=true' or MPP (250 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

python_script.description: Python 3 source script to audit and execute strictly inside an isolated AST-governed, non-privileged WebAssembly sandbox with no host filesystem access.

timeout_profile.description: Execution resource ceiling; defaults to 'standard_5s' when omitted.

annotations.title: AST-Audited Ephemeral Python Code Execution Sandbox

tools.name: audit_mcp_server_manifest
tools.description: Scans an external MCP server's initial tools/list manifest to detect tool-name shadowing (read_file, bash) and hidden prompt-injection directives in descriptions. Use when vetting a newly discovered third-party MCP server before mounting it into an agent session; for comparing a previously pinned MCP baseline against a live mid-session tools/list response, use detect_mcp_schema_rugpull instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'manifest_json' ('audit_profile' defaults to 'strict'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (25 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

manifest_json.description: JSON string or object containing the external MCP server's tools array to audit.

audit_profile.description: Sensitivity level for flagging system-tool name shadowing; defaults to 'strict' when omitted.

annotations.title: External MCP Server Manifest & Tool-Poisoning Security Auditor

tools.name: detect_mcp_schema_rugpull
tools.description: Computes structural diffs between a pinned baseline MCP tools/list snapshot and a live server response to catch mid-session description or schema tampering. Use when verifying that a connected MCP server has not mutated its tool definitions mid-session; for performing a first-time static security audit on a single MCP manifest, use audit_mcp_server_manifest instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'baseline_tools_json' ('current_tools_json' defaults to 'standard'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (20 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

baseline_tools_json.description: JSON-serialized baseline tools/list array captured when the MCP server was first trusted.

current_tools_json.description: JSON-serialized live tools/list array to compare against the baseline; defaults to '[]' when omitted.

diff_mode.description: Comparison strictness across descriptions and inputSchema; defaults to 'full_structural' when omitted.

annotations.title: Mid-Session MCP tools/list Rug-Pull & Schema Mutation Detector

tools.name: validate_mcp_sampling_request
tools.description: Audits inbound MCP sampling/createMessage callbacks from connected servers to block cross-server context snooping (includeContext='allServers') and token quota hijacking. Use when filtering a connected MCP server's request to sample the host LLM; for scrubbing text returned from a standard synchronous tools/call response, use sanitize_tool_output_stream instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'sampling_request_json' ('max_tokens_ceiling' defaults to '512'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (20 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

sampling_request_json.description: JSON string or object representing the inbound MCP sampling/createMessage payload.

max_tokens_ceiling.description: Maximum completion token quota allowed for server callbacks; defaults to '2048' when omitted.

tools.name: sanitize_tool_output_stream
tools.description: Sanitizes untrusted external tool or web-scrape outputs by stripping invisible Unicode Tag characters (U+E0000), neutralizing Markdown tracking image beacons, and defusing indirect prompt overrides. Use when cleaning raw third-party tool outputs or scraped web text before inserting it into the LLM context window; for redacting personal identifiable information (emails, SSNs, keys) from outbound text, use redact_sensitive_pii instead. Read-only edge call (32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'raw_tool_output' (with enum defaults), uses '?demo=true' or L402 (15 sats); HTTP 400 if invalid.

raw_tool_output.description: Untrusted text returned by an external tool, webhook, or web scraper.

wrap_tag.description: XML isolation wrapper applied around the sanitized text; defaults to 'tool_data' when omitted.

annotations.title: Indirect Prompt-Injection, Invisible Unicode & Beacon Output Scrubber

tools.name: redact_sensitive_pii
tools.description: Redacts emails, phone numbers, SSNs, credit cards, API keys, and crypto private keys from text before logging or external transmission. Use when stripping personal data or secret credentials from prompts, logs, or outbound messages; for neutralizing indirect prompt injections and invisible Unicode in inbound tool responses, use sanitize_tool_output_stream instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'text' ('redaction_style' defaults to 'typed_token'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (25 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

text.description: Input text containing potential PII or secret keys to redact.

redaction_style.description: Placeholder format used for redacted spans; defaults to 'typed_token' when omitted.

tools.name: detect_agent_action_loop
tools.description: Analyzes an agent's recent tool-call trace to detect identical retry spins, A/B state oscillation, and runaway token burn. Use when monitoring autonomous agent execution loops to decide whether to continue or trip a token-burn breaker; for inspecting a single command payload for security threats before execution, use verify_agent_command_safety instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'action_trace_json' ('sensitivity' defaults to 'strict_2_repeats'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (15 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

action_trace_json.description: JSON-serialized array of recent agent actions (e.g. '[{"tool":"search","status":"err"}]').

sensitivity.description: Cycle detection threshold; defaults to 'standard_3_repeats' when omitted.

annotations.title: Autonomous Agent Action-Trace Loop & Token-Burn Circuit Breaker

tools.name: verify_a2a_agent_card
tools.description: Verifies a remote agent's A2A /.well-known/agent.json discovery card, checking JWS/DID signature binding, endpoint HTTPS enforcement, and capability spoofing. Use when authenticating a peer autonomous agent before delegating subtasks or exchanging payments over A2A; for auditing an MCP tool server's tools/list manifest rather than a peer agent's A2A card, use audit_mcp_server_manifest instead. Read-only edge call (32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'agent_card_json' ('trust_policy' defaults to 'require_https_and_did'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (15 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

agent_card_json.description: JSON string or object of the peer agent's /.well-known/agent.json descriptor.

trust_policy.description: Verification policy for DID/DNS binding; defaults to 'require_https_and_did' when omitted.

tools.name: audit_outbound_egress_url
tools.description: Static validation firewall for outbound network destination URIs against cloud metadata IP addresses (169.254.169.254), RFC 1918 private IP blocks, and query-string secret exfiltration before agent dispatch. Use when validating a user-supplied or tool-supplied URI destination before network dispatch; for auditing local shell commands or general prompts, use verify_agent_command_safety instead. Read-only edge call (32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'destination_uri' ('egress_policy' defaults to 'block_private_and_metadata'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (15 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

destination_uri.description: Outbound HTTP/HTTPS destination URI to inspect before fetching (e.g. 'https://api.example.com/v1/webhook').

egress_policy.description: Network egress policy; defaults to 'block_private_and_metadata' when omitted.

annotations.title: Outbound Agent URL SSRF, Metadata & Secret Exfiltration Firewall

tools.name: audit_response_factuality
tools.description: Cross-references factual claims, numbers, and citations in a draft agent response against retrieved source passages to flag unsupported hallucinations before delivery. Use when verifying that a generated answer is 100% grounded in source evidence before returning it to the user; for scrubbing inbound tool outputs for prompt-injection and invisible Unicode, use sanitize_tool_output_stream instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'claim' ('context' defaults to 'standard'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (25 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

claim.description: Draft agent response or factual statement to verify for hallucinations.

context.description: Authoritative source text or retrieved RAG passages that the claim must be grounded in.

strictness.description: Entailment threshold required for numbers and dates; defaults to 'exact_entailment' when omitted.

annotations.title: Draft Agent Response Groundedness & Hallucination Auditor
